entries.speaker: Deivid Wisci
entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“It is unfortunate.”"

entries.dialogueText: “I have just received a communication from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Valgsland about our trade deal.”

entries.title: Deivid Wisci: "“Mr. President.”"

entries.dialogueText: “That's not all, Mr. President.”

entries.dialogueText: He handed me a document with the emblem of the Ministry of Economy of Valgsland on it.

entries.speaker: Player

entries.title: Player: "“Is something wrong?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Is something wrong?”

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: "“Deivid. Ready for the trip?”"
entries.dialogueText: “Deivid. Ready for the trip?”
